UPDATE campaigns
SET
  status = 'error',
  completed_at = NOW(),
  error_reason = 'WF1 execution failed — check n8n execution log for details'
WHERE id = {{ $('Postgres — Create Campaign1').first().json.id }};

INSERT INTO campaigns (business_type, city, country, source, max_results, search_query, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.business_type || "").substring(0, 255).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.city || "").substring(0, 255).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.country || "").substring(0, 10).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.source || "").substring(0, 20).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.limit }},
  '{{ ($json.search_query || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'running'
)
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO public.leads (
  external_id,
  source,
  business_name,
  category,
  phone,
  address,
  city,
  state,
  country,
  website_url,
  google_url,
  rating,
  review_count,
  search_query,
  campaign_id,
  status,
  failure_reason,
  created_at,
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.external_id || "").substring(0, 255).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.source || "").substring(0, 50).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.business_name || "").substring(0, 255).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.category || "").substring(0, 255).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.phone || "").substring(0, 50).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.address || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.city || "").substring(0, 100).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.state || "").substring(0, 100).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.country || "").substring(0, 10).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.website_url || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.google_url || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.rating !== null && $json.rating !== undefined && $json.rating !== "" ? $json.rating : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.review_count !== null && $json.review_count !== undefined && $json.review_count !== "" ? $json.review_count : "NULL" }},
  '{{ ($json.search_query || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.campaign_id ? $json.campaign_id : "NULL" }},
  '{{ ($json.status || "new").substring(0, 50).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.failure_reason
    ? "'" + String($json.failure_reason).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"
    : "NULL"
  }},
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (external_id)
WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL
DO NOTHING
RETURNING
  id,
  external_id,
  business_name,
  campaign_id,
  status;

UPDATE campaigns
SET
  leads_found = {{ $json.leads_found }},
  leads_inserted = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE campaign_id = {{ $json.campaign_id }}),
  status = 'completed',
  completed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.campaign_id }};

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  leads_processed,
  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
)
VALUES (
  'lead_generation',
  {{ $json.leads_processed || 0 }},
  {{ $json.leads_failed || 0 }},
  {{ $json.duration_ms || 0 }},
  '{{ ($json.notes || "WF1 completed").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
);
